# sonrai_pending_changes (Data Source)

Lists the changes a `sonrai_control_submission` under a root scope would deploy if it ran now with this token: those the token's identity has staged and not yet submitted, and those the platform has queued for the whole organization. Changes another user staged are not listed, because that user's submission deploys them, not this one.

It is read while planning, before this configuration stages anything, so what it lists came from somewhere else: an earlier apply that did not finish, another configuration or a console session using the same identity, or the platform. Do not give it a `depends_on` on the controls. That defers the read until they have staged, and it then lists them too.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What a submission under this root scope would deploy if it ran now, before
# this configuration stages anything of its own.
data "sonrai_pending_changes" "firewall" {
  root_scope = "aws/r-abcd"
}

output "already_pending" {
  value = [for c in data.sonrai_pending_changes.firewall.changes : c.name]
}

# Reported as a warning on every plan and apply, without blocking either. A
# precondition on the submission would block instead, but it would also block
# the apply that recovers from one that staged changes and then failed.
check "nothing_unexpected_is_pending" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.sonrai_pending_changes.firewall.total == 0
    error_message = "${data.sonrai_pending_changes.firewall.total} change(s) are already pending and will be deployed by the next submission."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `root_scope` (String) Cloud organization root scope, for example `aws/r-abcd`.

### Read-Only

- `changes` (Attributes List) The pending changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--changes))
- `id` (String) Same as `root_scope`.
- `total` (Number) Number of pending changes.

<a id="nestedatt--changes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `changes`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What the change does, for example `ADD` or `REMOVE`.
- `change_type` (String) Kind of change as the platform reports it, for example `mapping`, `exception`, `exemption`, `region`, `third_party_access` or `third_party_account`.
- `control_key` (String) Control, third party or policy the change concerns, where it has one.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the change, unique within its `change_type`.
- `identities` (List of String) Identities or accounts the change adds or removes, where it has any.
- `name` (String) Description of the change, as Pending Changes shows it in the console.
- `organization_wide` (Boolean) True when the platform queued the change for every submitter rather than this identity staging it: updates to known third party accounts, and edits to custom controls and organization policies that are already deployed.
- `resource_id` (String) Cloud-native id of `scope`: what resources take as `resource_id`.
- `scope` (String) Scope the change applies to.
- `staged_by` (String) Identity the platform reports the change under. Changes queued by the platform are reported under the caller, so use `organization_wide` to tell them apart.
